bitcoinKey: This looks like a Bitcoin private key. Anyone who sees it can take your funds. Send anyway?
cashu: This is a Cashu token: it is money, and whoever redeems it first keeps it. Once sent it cannot be taken back.
hexKey: This looks like a private key or a seed. Anyone who sees it can take your funds or act as you. Send anyway?
mnemonic: This looks like a wallet seed. Anyone who sees it can take your funds. Send anyway?
nsec: This looks like a Nostr private key (nsec). Anyone who sees it can post as you and read your private messages. Send anyway?
